note: Set B is better because it captures the spectral wavelength bands for all three channels (Blue, Red, IR), which are fundamental definitions of the channels, whereas Set A only captures one Red band. Set B also extracts Telescope Resolution and Spectrometer Resolution for all channels, providing a more complete picture of optical performance. Set A is stronger on hardware components (Detectors, Deformable Mirrors for all channels), but the omission of most wavelength data and Telescope Resolution is a significant gap in channel specifications. Set B misses the Red Channel Deformable Mirror specs and all IWA values, but overall provides better coverage of the defining optical characteristics.
